notes: Baked checkerboards removed; all delivered PNGs and WebP animation frames carry real alpha transparency.
Character details are retained; edges and previously flattened smoky effects have reconstructed alpha.
Original four-keyframe sequences, timing, image dimensions and crop coordinates are retained.
Original pose alignment and effect spill at cell boundaries still warrant production review.
No game source code was modified.

characters.name: Reed Lurker
characters.designBrief: A long, low QUADRUPED crocodile, dark jade armored scales, sand-colored belly, papyrus reeds tangled along its spine, narrow golden eyes, teeth, four short clawed legs and long thick tail. A dangerous river animal, not a humanoid and not a snake.

characters.name: Marsh Shade
characters.designBrief: A drowned Egyptian male boatman's ghost: gaunt turquoise spectral face, hollow pale eyes, tattered off-white linen shroud, rope belt, elongated cold hands, ragged vaporous lower legs. Human ghost silhouette with readable cloth, not a black void entity.

characters.name: Sand Crawler
characters.designBrief: A low six-legged Egyptian scarab beetle with ochre sandstone carapace scratched with old turquoise spells, black jointed legs, large paired forward pincers and tiny amber eyes. Distinct beetle anatomy, no human limbs. Agile medium insect.

characters.name: Sekhen the Reed Serpent
characters.designBrief: A massive legless reed-green serpent lord, layered jade scales crusted with silt, golden pale ventral plates, long papyrus fronds forming a crest behind the snake head, small antique-gold Egyptian brow ornament, amber predatory eyes. Thick coils at base; clearly a snake with no arms or legs. Reed-region boss.

characters.name: Ember Wraith
characters.designBrief: A tall lean human-shaped Egyptian fire revenant, charcoal body with angular orange cracks, burning head and crown of flame, strips of scorched linen and small gold funerary collar. Silhouette made from solid readable charcoal torso and flame-edged limbs; non-graphic, no exposed organs.

characters.name: Flamekeeper of the Fourth Hour
characters.designBrief: A broad-shouldered Egyptian gatekeeper in dark iron and gold lamellar armor, ivory linen kilt, an open bronze BRAZIER FOR A HEAD filled with orange flame, no human face, heavy branding staff in right hand and rectangular coal-dark shield on left arm. Normal tall guardian proportions, distinct from a squat bronze statue.

characters.name: Ash Jackal
characters.designBrief: A lean QUADRUPED jackal with tall pointed ears, charcoal-black fur, glowing cinder-orange fissures, ember paws, long bushy smoke-tipped tail, small tarnished bronze Egyptian collar. Four canine legs and canine head; not Anubis or a humanoid. Red-orange eyes.

characters.name: Nehebkau, the Furnace Coil
characters.designBrief: A gigantic legless Egyptian furnace serpent with obsidian plated scales split by molten orange seams, cream-gold underside, heavy dark basalt brow crest and tarnished gold neck rings; white-hot eyes and contained flames between coils. Large thick coiled body, powerful snake head, NO arms legs or wings. Fire-region boss.

characters.name: Devourer Spawn
characters.designBrief: A low heavy QUADRUPED Ammit-inspired Egyptian monster: crocodile jaws, tawny lion forequarters with dark mane, slate hippopotamus hindquarters, four strong clawed legs and reptilian tail. Small gold funerary collar, violet eyes, a touch of black-violet bile at jaws. Organic hide, NO external bone armor. Chunky predatory silhouette.

characters.name: Shadow of the Uncreated
characters.designBrief: An unnaturally tall featureless humanoid void silhouette, matte midnight-violet body, jagged smoky edges, long tapered hands and feet, a thin pale-violet eye slit and a broken antique-gold Egyptian collar floating at neck. No linen shroud, no skull, no conventional face; primordial absence with restrained violet rim light.

characters.name: Hour-Eater
characters.designBrief: An original Egyptian time-devouring demon, gaunt jackal-skull ceremonial mask with ivory elongated snout, dark indigo mummified humanoid body, antique gold hourglass embedded in ribcage containing glowing sand, gold-and-lapis striped nemes, long clawed hands, ragged deep violet kilt. One coherent hourglass chest, no text or clock numbers.

characters.name: Apep — The Head That Bites
characters.designBrief: A colossal legless black Egyptian chaos serpent, extremely thick obsidian scales with deep-violet edges, blood-red eyes, ivory recurved fangs, broad angular snake skull, torn antique-gold brow band. Heavy river-filling coils condensed into complete readable silhouette. One head, no limbs wings or dragon horns. Final boss HEAD phase: head raised prominently above compact coils, black venom glints at jaws.

characters.name: Silt Colossus
characters.designBrief: A gigantic squat six-legged scarab colossus, much heavier than the Sand Crawler, broad boulder-like shell clad in thick cracked riverbed silt slabs and old submerged temple stones, moss, jade seams and small golden ancient markings, huge blunt pincers, six stout rock-armored insect legs. A scarab, not a biped stone golem.

characters.name: Bronze Effigy
characters.designBrief: A hulking squat Egyptian furnace idol cast entirely in burnished bronze, massive rounded layered chest and shoulders, stocky bronze legs, fixed ceremonial expressionless mask with narrow glowing orange eye slits, small crown brazier atop head, molten seams. Oversized built-in slab forearms used as shields and bludgeons, no separate staff. Clearly an armored living statue, distinct from tall Flamekeeper.

characters.name: Boneplate Devourer
characters.designBrief: A heavy QUADRUPED Ammit creature with crocodile head, lion forequarters, hippopotamus rear, four muscular legs, covered in large overlapping pale ivory bone plates and heart-shaped funerary shield scales. Violet seams between bone, dark hide, gold collar. Distinct armored evolution of Devourer Spawn; no gore, no exposed flesh. Broad plated head and bone ridges.

characters.name: Apep — The Coils That Crush
characters.designBrief: SAME Apep character: colossal legless black chaos serpent, obsidian scales edged violet, red eyes, ivory fangs, antique-gold brow band, one head no limbs wings or horns. COILS phase: the small lowered head stays behind three enormous raised looping coils; coils dominate the silhouette and crush invisible space at the center. Do not add barque or scenery.

characters.name: Apep — The Maw
characters.designBrief: SAME Apep character: colossal black legless chaos serpent, obsidian scales edged violet, red eyes, ivory fangs, torn antique-gold brow band, one head no limbs wings or horns. MAW phase: reared head with enormous opened jaws, small eclipsed golden sun orb contained inside mouth, violet-gold energy outlining throat, coiled base remains fully visible. Boss turned toward swallowing dawn; no scenery.

backgroundCleanup.method: Python colour and spatial segmentation; edge decontamination; selective smoke matting
